why.ar: تلتف الأكياس حول آلات الفرز وتعطّلها

entries.en: The paper is dry and clean

entries.en: I wrapped any broken glass carefully

entries.en: I will not put it in the general waste

entries.en: I will take it to a collection point

why.en: Devices are dismantled safely there and their materials recovered
